svg.title: Figure 10 · Randomized quasi-Monte Carlo on a one-dimensional payoff
svg.desc: 32 independent repetitions per method and N; IID seed 1005, separate Sobol scramble seeds. Each Sobol sample has 2^m points. The comparison uses exact BSM truth; this favourable one-dimensional result is not a universal convergence-rate guarantee.
